schema:name: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine 2D Mapping v1
schema:description: Pallasite olivine 2D mapping in cool plasma mode (800 W) is a core methodological innovation; total of 8 PMG meteorites mapped; P-rich veinlets excluded from olivine averages; Fa# values verified against EMPA (Fig. 5A)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Form Analytical Substrate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: In situ — polished epoxy thick section (HELEX II two-volume cell)

schema:additionalType: Double-focusing sector field ICP-MS (explicitly stated: "Thermo Scientific Element XR double-focusing sector field ICP-MS unit")

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Configuration
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Coolant Plasma Gas Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:description: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.81 l min⁻¹ (mapping)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma Thermal Mode
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Cool plasma (800 W RF) to reduce Ar-based argide interferences on ⁶⁰Ni and ⁷¹Ga

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Daily tuning; cool plasma conditions optimized; N₂ explicitly not added to avoid N-based interferences

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Memory Effect Mitigation
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Gas blank measured before each ablation line; adequate washout ensured by duty cycle timing

schema:instrument.schema:name: example instrumentName

schema:model.schema:name: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)

schema:instrument.ada:laserType: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns
schema:instrument.schema:name: HELEX II two-volume ablation cell

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate Mapping Rate or Step Size
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:description: Ar make-up: 0.81–0.99 l min⁻¹ (mapping); N₂ explicitly not added

ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault: He: MFC-1 (cell) 0.200–0.260 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 (cup) 0.220–0.385 l min⁻¹

schema:step.schema:name: Sample preparation
schema:step.schema:description: PMG thick sections polished; HELEX II two-volume cell; C-coated for SEM then coating removed before LA

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Signal Smoothing
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: None (no signal smoothing device; N₂ not added)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Manual identification and exclusion of P-rich veinlet pixels from olivine averages; anomalous spikes from inclusions excluded per line

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Applied: triple mode detection; cross-calibration between pulse-counting and analog modes performed

ada:analysisSequenceDefault: (i) Gas blanks → (ii) all glass GRMs for external calibration → (iii) 1–3 cosmic spherule unknowns → (iv) blanks → (v) all glass GRMs again
ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: Scans for gas blank: 10 per line (before each mapping line); 80 scans during ablation

schema:creator.schema:name: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.

schema:location.schema:name: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium

schema:funding.schema:name: Planet Topers (BELSPO Interuniversity Attraction Poles); FWO postdoctoral fellowship for SCh; FWO "Excellence of Science" (ET-HoME ID 30442502); FWO/BOF-UGent; Alexander von Humboldt Foundation; FWO/BELSPO/VUB for SG and PC

schema:target.schema:name: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method

ada:rasterLineSpacingDefault: 20 µm (contiguous; 20×20 µm square spot = line spacing equals spot width)
ada:internalStandardApproach: Sum-of-major-oxide normalization: MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ = 100 wt% per pixel (Liu et al. 2008 approach; no EPMA required for IS)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Internal normalization to MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ oxide sum corrects for point-to-point ablation yield variation; additional pixel-by-pixel normalization fixes oxide sum to 100 wt%
ada:calibrationMeasurementFrequency: Each GRM analyzed 3–5× before and 3–5× after sample analyses (all GRMs at start and end of session)
ada:oxideProductionMethodAndThreshold: ThO⁺/Th⁺ (mass 248/232); threshold not explicitly stated but minimized by cool plasma
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas blank measured before each ablation line (10 scans of gas blank per mapping line); average background subtracted from each corresponding ablation line
ada:internalStandardElement: No single IS element; oxide sum normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅) used as virtual IS per pixel
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Manual visual inspection of time-resolved signal per line; anomalous spikes (inclusions, cracks, veinlets) excluded; P-rich veinlet regions identified and excluded from olivine averages
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialDefault: MPI-DING glasses: GOR132-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G; USGS: BCR-2G, BHVO-2G — measured as unknowns alongside samples and compared to GeoReM preferred values (Table 1 and Section 3.3)
ada:primaryStandardNameDefault: Multiple glass GRMs used together for linear regression external calibration: NIST SRM 612, NIST SRM 614, USGS GSD-1G (synthetic), USGS GSE-1G (synthetic), USGS BHVO-2G, USGS BIR-1G (natural basalt glasses)
